title: Ansel and the Drop
author: Astrid Sterling
blurb: Kestrel Winterbourne, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
